footer.compliance: Compliant with DEFRA 2023 & ICAO Greenhouse Gas Accounting Standards.

home.subheading: EcoRoute generates candidate itineraries, ranks them across carbon, cost, time and your preferences using multi-objective optimization, and explains each recommendation in plain language.

features.title: Multi-objective optimization
features.description: NSGA-II Pareto ranking balances carbon, cost, time, and your preference in one pass.

features.title: Real emission factors
features.description: DEFRA 2023 and ICAO-sourced figures, not guesses — every number is traceable.

features.title: Plain-language explanations
features.description: An LLM turns the computed numbers into a 2-3 sentence rationale for each option.
